subject: Shiny bug with rCharts? Attempt to apply non-function

messages.author: bda90bcea347c4f0
messages.subject: Shiny bug with rCharts? Attempt to apply non-function
parts:
runGist("https://gist.github.com/tcash21/6249827")

I'm seeing an 'attempt to apply non-function' error every time I switch inputs. It flashes on the mainPanel quickly, but you can see it in the console.
Is this a shiny bug or is there a way for me to tryCatch this behavior?

messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Shiny bug with rCharts? Attempt to apply non-function
parts:
This error is occurring since renderChart2 is expecting an object belonging to an rCharts class. You might be able to rewrite the server side function such that renderChart2 is called only when the inputs defining the chart have been specified. A quick hack to resolve this within the code you have is to return an empty rChart instead of invisible. So essentially, modify the return(invisible()) statements in your code to return(rCharts$new()). This should not have any undesirable side effects since an empty chart wont print anything.

Hope this helps.
